readerCopy.summary: The public appeal says there is enough support to go around, while the people distributing it describe shortages and impossible choices.
readerCopy.body: The public appeal says there is enough support to go around, while the people distributing it describe shortages and impossible choices. Donors point to the money raised; caregivers and local workers point to rent, food, beds, and time that the headline total does not automatically provide. The Moon keeps daily shortages from disappearing beneath the headline total, while Jupiter defends the larger promise that more help can solve them. The opposition places abundance across from the limits of how care is actually delivered. The campaign may remain successful on paper while the people closest to the crisis decide whose need can be met first.
